## Project Overview

My project will investigate the distribution and prevalence of police surveillance technologies across the borough of Manhattan in New York City, and conduct an analysis based on the relative racial demographic makeup of each region/neighborhood. The goal of this research is to create geospatial visualization(s) of how race may interact with the level and perhaps the type of policing and surveillance infrastructure in a major US city characterized by many diverse racial/ethnic groups living in a highly residentially-segregated geographical area. If there is a racial component and/or a disparate nature of policing/use of police force, I aim to outline how and to what extent these disparities map onto the different neighborhoods.
